name: Stormbringer: Thundershocker works natively (#1682)
contract: #1682: Thundershocker (300610) is a flat SPELLMOD_EFFECT3 (23, i.e. effect index 2) modifier, EffectBasePoints 29 + DieSides 1 = +30, class mask (0,0,2), which matches Eye of the Storm's own family-22 flags (0,0,2). The chain is 806307 -> periodic trigger 806455 -> trigger 807712, and 807712's own effect 2 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_FROM_CASTER (base 0); the modifier raises that amount from 0 to 30 on the root debuff itself, so 'while rooted by Eye of the Storm' is satisfied by construction. Unit::SpellDamageBonusTaken applies it to any family-22 hit from the same caster (Unit.cpp), read here through spell_damage_taken on the rooted dummy (fixed base 1000 per apps/coa-gameplay-test/README.md, target identifies the attacker), giving 1000 -> 1300. The root is snapshotted at application time, so the Thundershocker half re-triggers it after learning the talent instead of re-reading a stale one. The Arm of Thorim cast is only an unmodified baseline: its triggered stun 570339 keeps its SpellDuration.dbc id 36 base of 1000 ms and the SPELLMOD_DURATION query stays 1000 because this scenario never learns High Voltage 570191. The #2154 extension to 2000 ms is exercised by stormbringer-lightning-chain-family-high-voltage.json, which learns 570191 and recasts on a dummy that was never stunned. Arm of Thorim (501433-501437) is also gated by the class-16 custom resource system (AscensionCompatData::ResourceCostRules, src/server/coa/AscensionCustomResourceData.h): it requires at least 1 stack of the 'Static' resource aura 803102 and consumes it entirely on cast (Consumption::All); AscensionResourceService::CheckCast (src/server/coa/AscensionCompat.cpp) returns SPELL_FAILED_NO_POWER when the caster holds fewer stacks than required, independently of actual mana. The fixture grants 1 Static stack via set_aura immediately before each Arm of Thorim cast, since the cast fully drains it. Eye of the Storm (806307) and Arm of Thorim (501433) share StartRecoveryCategory 133 (the standard 1000-1500 ms global cooldown, Spell.cpp TriggerGlobalCooldown/GlobalCooldownMgr, keyed only by StartRecoveryCategory, independent of the per-spell cooldown reset_cooldown clears): the Arm of Thorim BASELINE cast triggers that shared GCD, so the Thundershocker recast of 806307 must wait for it to clear before casting, not only for 806307's own 30 s category cooldown (cleared by reset_cooldown). Eye of the Storm's 806455, Arm of Thorim and its stun are magic spells that can miss a level-80 target, which left the root or the stun missing, so the caster carries spell_hit_rating. aura_duration_ms is the remaining duration, read at least one world update after the stun lands, so the baseline bounds it by 1000 ms rather than equating it (990 ms was read after a 10 ms step and 810 ms after a slow real-clock update).

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
SETUP: the fixture has enough mana for a 37% base mana cast
Let the periodic trigger apply the root
BASELINE: Eye of the Storm's root debuff is applied
BASELINE: the root's own damage-from-caster amount is 0 without Thundershocker
BASELINE: Forked Lightning's incoming-damage query is the metric's fixed 1000 against the rooted target
SETUP: the fixture carries the Static charge Arm of Thorim's resource gate consumes (ResourceCostRules class 16, 501433-501437, amount 1, Consumption::All)
BASELINE: Arm of Thorim's triggered stun is applied
BASELINE: Arm of Thorim's stun has at most its DBC 1000 ms left
BASELINE: the stun duration modifier query is unmodified
Let the shared GCD (StartRecoveryCategory 133, 1000-1500 ms) triggered by the Arm of Thorim BASELINE cast clear before recasting Eye of the Storm, which shares that category
Let the periodic trigger re-apply the root with Thundershocker learned
DISCRIMINATING: Thundershocker raises the root's damage-from-caster amount to 30
DISCRIMINATING: Forked Lightning's incoming-damage query against the rooted target rises to 1300
